inShort: A and B hit every ball as softly as possible, with a loose arm and a follow-through that touches the opposite shoulder.
rules: A and B stand across from each other at the kitchen line.
First a check: A lifts B's arm at the backswing and at the finish. Heavy and the shoulder drops? Loose. Then swap.
Hit every ball as softly as possible. Hold the paddle loosely, about 1 out of 5.
Every follow-through goes all the way over and touches the opposite shoulder.
Keep speeding up through the ball. Don't slow down and push.
Give the ball a little height at first, so you have time to finish. Forehands and backhands.
tooEasy: Count clean soft shots with a full finish in a row, up to 20; a missed finish starts again. Even harder: switch forehand and backhand on every ball.
tooHard: Hit higher and slower until the full finish happens every time.
goodLooksLike: The arm swings through to the shoulder without stopping short, and the ball floats slowly over the net and drops into the kitchen.
